QuestInfo.name: A Student of the Resistance
QuestInfo.0: Now you're a member of the Resistance! To find out what a member of the Resistance does, ask #b#p2151002##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151002# says she can't send you on a mission until you reach at least #bLv. 14#k first. You can hunt to earn EXP to level up, but there is also an educational program available to Resistance members. Speak with #b#p2151010#, the Instructor#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met with #p2151010# and asked about the educational program for the Resistance.

0.0: (Belle studies your spindly, unmuscled body.)\r\nI'd love to give you a mission, but at your level, you're more of a risk than an asset. I'd hate to have to chase after you to rescue you... So first, advance to #bLv. 14#k. That's your mission.

yes.0: Gain experience to level up. You can gain EXP by hunting monsters, but participating in the #bResistance Educational Program#k might be faster.
yes.1: #p2151010# is in charge of the Resistance Educational Program. You should talk with #b#p2151010##k at #b#m310010010##k.
yes.2: Then see you at our next training session. I look forward to your achievements as a member of the Resistance.

no.0: I don't care if you don't like it, I can't give a mission to someone who is below Lv. 14. Be patient and train hard, and you'll be able to take on more important missions in the future.

1.0: We meet again. Congratulations on becoming a member of the Resistance! I've had my eye on you. I believe #p2151002# sensed potential in you when they sent you here.

npc.0: You haven't gone to see #b#p2151010##k yet? Are you serious about the helping the Resistance or not?
